about_short_description.short_description: Method Financial is a financial connectivity API for consumer liability data and payments.

product.name: Method Connect
product.description: An API that connects users' credit and liability accounts across 15,000+ financial institutions using personal information and multi-factor authentication without requiring login credentials.

product.name: Method Data
product.description: Provides real-time, comprehensive financial liability data including balances, transactions, due dates, payoff quotes, credit limits, and interest rates from multiple sources.

product.name: Method Pay
product.description: An API that enables initiating payments and balance transfers to any consumer liability account in the US with real-time settlement and payment confirmation.

product.name: Method Elements
product.description: A suite of embeddable debt management components that integrate easily into applications to enable features like balance transfers and account validation.

product.name: Method Dashboard
product.description: A purpose-built dashboard that provides teams with access to onboarding, payment management, account reconciliation, and reporting features.

product.name: Portfolio Intelligence
product.description: A continuous borrower-monitoring and intelligence tool that helps lenders identify financial changes, qualification signals, and opportunities for follow-up offers.
